cues.title: Introducing Aloha
cues.note: [The explosion becomes the true-story joke, then Aloha. Say nothing.]

cues.title: Attachment issues
cues.note: This is Cio. We gave a C-arm attachment issues.

cues.title: Disconnected
cues.note: It can see your bones. It cannot see your Wi-Fi.

cues.title: Patch overdue
cues.note: Patch overdue. Feed the beast.

cues.title: Updating
cues.note: Emotionally unavailable. Technically updating.

cues.title: Connected and current
cues.note: New firmware. Who dis?

cues.title: Update failed
cues.note: Something fails? It would like to speak to your developer.

cues.title: Recovery
cues.note: Recovery: this never happened. [Beat.] The audit log disagrees.

cues.title: The personality loop
cues.note: [Let the accelerating faces and TV shutdown land.]

cues.title: Now
cues.note: Now. Let’s put the little menace to work.

cues.title: The actual problem
cues.note: Its mood tells us what needs attention. Hospital data tells us when.

cues.title: An opening
cues.note: A cancelled case opens a gap.

cues.title: The search
cues.note: Our scheduler searches the real prototype rules. Most attractive-looking gaps are terrible dates.

cues.title: The boundaries
cues.note: Keep emergency cover, a replacement machine and recovery time available.

cues.title: The match
cues.note: This window survives the checks. Medical physics can review the proposal.

cues.title: The scheduler
cues.note: Meet the calendar goblins. The joke is optional. The scheduling code runs.

cues.title: The physical helper
cues.note: Our proposed senior plugging-in engineer brings power and approved data, then checks identity and surroundings.

cues.title: The human gate
cues.note: We kept one very sophisticated component: a human with a thumb.

cues.title: Start
cues.note: The rules must pass. A human still presses start.

cues.title: The result
cues.note: Results, logs and exceptions return to the team. The browser prototype runs the plan; hospital and hardware integration come next.

cues.title: Less drama
cues.note: Less machine drama.

cues.title: More care
cues.note: More human care. [Hold the silence. The pitch is finished.]
